title: Get Listed on Google - Google Business Profile CA

facts.fact: Google describes its Business Profile listing as free to create and manage on Google Search and Maps.
facts.quote: Take control of how your free Business Profile appears on Google Search and Maps.

facts.fact: Google's page states that multiple Google Ads campaigns can be created within the same account without creating a new account.
facts.value: multiple campaigns in the same account
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.
